name: basher

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

smoke: export PATH="$BASHER_ROOT/bin:$PATH"; basher commands | grep -qx link; mkdir -p "$HOME/localpkg/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nprintf basher-local-ok\n' > "$HOME/localpkg/bin/offline-demo"; chmod +x "$HOME/localpkg/bin/offline-demo"; "$BASHER_ROOT/bin/basher" uninstall local/demo >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; basher link --no-deps "$HOME/localpkg" local/demo; test "$("$BASHER_ROOT/cellar/bin/offline-demo")" = basher-local-ok
notes: Runs official installer with source transport replaced by pinned archive; BASHER_ROOT carries requested prefix. Preserves startup integration. Explicit repeat verification checks installed source pin; tests linking and executing a local package without dependencies.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
